jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery is responsible for bringing the next generation of guest experiences to life across MSC Cruises' new class of ships.
Working closely with the Product Innovation team, this role transforms approved concepts into fully realized onboard experiences, ensuring they are operationally executable, commercially successful, and aligned with the MSC Cruises brand.
Leading the development and delivery of end-to-end guest journeys, service concepts, and onboard experiences, the Sr. Director ensures every experience is launch-ready from ship design and operational planning to crew delivery and guest activation.
The role also plays a key part in defining how new experiences are presented to guests, partnering with internal teams to shape compelling storytelling, positioning, and go-to-market strategies that maximize guest engagement and commercial impact.
As a trusted partner to senior leadership, the Sr. Director regularly presents progress, recommendations, and delivery strategies to executive stakeholders, including the CEO and Chairman, ensuring alignment from concept approval through successful launch.

Your Impact

Experience Development & Delivery

-
Lead the end-to-end development and delivery of new guest experiences, from approved concept through ship launch.

-
Translate approved concepts into guest journeys, service models, operational requirements, and launch plans.

-
Ensure every experience remains true to the original vision while being operationally feasible, commercially successful, and aligned with MSC Cruises' brand standards.

Guest Experience Excellence

-
Champion guest-centric experiences that combine hospitality, storytelling, service excellence, and commercial performance.

-
Design memorable end-to-end guest journeys that create emotional engagement and enhance guest satisfaction.

-
Apply industry best practices and continuous innovation to elevate onboard experiences across the fleet.

Cross-Functional Leadership

-
Lead collaboration across Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architects, designers, and external partners to successfully deliver new guest experiences.

-
Ensure alignment between ship design, construction milestones, operational readiness, and launch activities.

-
Manage stakeholder expectations, priorities, risks, dependencies, and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Project & Delivery Management

-
Oversee project plans, budgets, timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.

-
Support the SVP with budget oversight, executive reporting, strategic recommendations, and delivery governance.

-
Ensure projects are properly planned, resourced, and delivered on time, within scope, and in line with business objectives.

Executive Communication

-
Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and project updates for senior leadership, including the CEO and Chairman.

-
Clearly communicate delivery progress, key decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations.

-
Support executive decision-making with data-driven insights, operational considerations, and guest experience perspectives.

Team Leadership

-
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of guest experience professionals.

-
Build capabilities in guest journey design, hospitality delivery, stakeholder management, project execution, and operational integration.

-
Foster a collaborative, accountable, innovative, and guest-first culture while developing future leadership talent.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

-
Define, monitor, and report KPIs related to launch readiness, guest satisfaction, operational adoption, experience quality, and commercial performance.

-
Lead post-launch evaluations, capture lessons learned, and implement continuous improvements to strengthen future experience delivery.

-
Drive a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across all guest experience development activities.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

- 12+ years of experience in designing and delivering physical, in-space guest experiences within hospitality, cruise ships, resorts, themed entertainment, or similar service-driven environments, with a clear focus on onboard or on-site experiences rather than digital products.

- Proven track record of leading large-scale, guest-facing physical experience projects from concept through implementation in complex operational environments such as ships, hotels, or resorts.

- Strong understanding of physical guest experience design, hospitality operations, service excellence, and in-person customer journey development within built environments.

- Demonstrated ability to translate strategic concepts into operationally executable, tangible experiences and launch plans within physical spaces.

- Experienced leader with a proven ability to build, develop, and inspire high-performing, cross-functional teams.

- Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership and Board-level audiences.

- Strong commercial, financial, and analytical mindset, balancing guest experience, operational feasibility, timelines, and investment.

- Experience collaborating with designers, architects, creative agencies, and operational teams to deliver immersive, physical environments and experiences.

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) and presentation tools to develop compelling concepts and executive communications focused on physical experience delivery.

- Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally up to 30%.

Your Essentials

-

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery è responsabile di portare la prossima generazione di esperienze ospiti in vita attraverso la nuova classe di navi di MSC Crociere. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il team Product Innovation, questo ruolo trasforma i concetti approvati in esperienze a bordo completamente realizzate, garantendo che siano eseguibili operativamente, commercialmente di successo e allineati con il marchio MSC Cruises. Conducendo lo sviluppo e la consegna di viaggi ospiti end-to-end, concetti di servizio e esperienze a bordo, il Direttore Sr. assicura che ogni esperienza sia pronta al lancio dalla progettazione navale e dalla pianificazione operativa alla consegna dell'equipaggio e all'attivazione degli ospiti. Il ruolo svolge anche un ruolo chiave nella definizione di come vengono presentate nuove esperienze agli ospiti, collaborando con i team interni per plasmare interessanti strategie di storytelling, posizionamento e go-to-market che massimizzano il coinvolgimento degli ospiti e l'impatto commerciale. Come partner affidabile per la leadership senior, il Direttore Sr. presenta regolarmente progressi, raccomandazioni e strategie di consegna per gli stakeholders esecutivi, tra cui il CEO e il Presidente, garantendo l'allineamento dall'approvazione del concetto attraverso il lancio di successo. Il tuo impatto Sviluppo e consegna dell'esperienza - Condurre lo sviluppo end-to-end e la consegna di nuove esperienze ospiti, dal concetto approvato attraverso il lancio della nave. - Traduci concetti approvati in viaggi ospiti, modelli di servizio, requisiti operativi e piani di lancio. - Assicurarsi che ogni esperienza rimanga fedele alla visione originale, pur essendo fattibile operativamente, commercialmente di successo, e allineato con gli standard del marchio MSC Crociere. Esperienza degli ospiti - Esperienze incentrate sugli ospiti campione che combinano ospitalità, storytelling, eccellenza del servizio e performance commerciali. - Progettare memorabili viaggi ospiti end-to-end che creano impegno emotivo e migliorare la soddisfazione degli ospiti. - Applicare le migliori pratiche del settore e l'innovazione continua per elevare esperienze a bordo in tutta la flotta. Leadership trasversale - Lead collaborazione tra Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architetti, designer e partner esterni per offrire nuove esperienze agli ospiti. - Assicurare l'allineamento tra progettazione navale, pietre miliari di costruzione, disponibilità operativa e attività di lancio. - Gestisci le aspettative, le priorità, i rischi, le dipendenze e il processo decisionale in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto. Gestione del progetto e della consegna - Superare i piani di progetto, i budget, le linee temporali, le pietre miliari, i rischi e i materiali di consegna attraverso molteplici iniziative. - Sostenere il SVP con la supervisione del bilancio, la rendicontazione esecutiva, le raccomandazioni strategiche e la governance della consegna. - Assicurare che i progetti siano adeguatamente pianificati, informatizzati e consegnati in tempo, nell'ambito e in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali. Comunicazione - Preparare e fornire presentazioni ad alto impatto e aggiornamenti di progetto per la leadership senior, tra cui il CEO e il Presidente. - Comunica chiaramente i progressi della consegna, le decisioni chiave, i rischi, i trade-off e le raccomandazioni. - Sostenere il processo decisionale esecutivo con intuizioni basate sui dati, considerazioni operative e prospettive di esperienza degli ospiti. Leadership del team - Guidare, allenare e sviluppare un team altamente performante di professionisti dell'esperienza degli ospiti. - Costruire le capacità nella progettazione del viaggio degli ospiti, la consegna dell'ospitalità, la gestione degli stakeholder, l'esecuzione del progetto e l'integrazione operativa. - Promuovere una cultura collaborativa, responsabile, innovativa e guest-first, sviluppando il futuro talento di leadership. Prestazioni e miglioramento continuo - Definire, monitorare e segnalare i KPI relativi alla disponibilità di lancio, soddisfazione degli ospiti, adozione operativa, qualità dell'esperienza e prestazioni commerciali. - Condurre valutazioni post-lancio, acquisire lezioni apprese e implementare miglioramenti continui per rafforzare la consegna futura esperienza. - Guidare una cultura di eccellenza, innovazione e miglioramento continuo in tutte le attività di sviluppo dell'esperienza degli ospiti. Il tuo viaggio finora - Corso di laurea richiesto; MBA o altro grado avanzato preferito. - 12+ anni di esperienza nella progettazione e nella fornitura di esperienze fisiche e in-spaziali all'interno dell'ospitalità, navi da crociera, resort, intrattenimento a tema, o simili ambienti orientati al servizio, con una chiara attenzione su esperienze onboard o on-site piuttosto che prodotti digitali. - Provato record di grandi progetti di esperienza fisica di fronte agli ospiti dal concetto attraverso l'implementazione in ambienti operativi complessi come navi, hotel o resort. - Forte comprensione del design dell'esperienza fisica degli ospiti, le operazioni di ospitalità, l'eccellenza del servizio e lo sviluppo del viaggio del cliente in persona all'interno di ambienti costruiti. - Dimostrata capacità di tradurre concetti strategici in esperienze attuabili, tangibili e di lanciare piani all'interno di spazi fisici. - Leader esperto con una comprovata capacità di costruire, sviluppare e ispirare team altamente performanti e interfunzionali. - Ottima gestione degli stakeholder, influenza e capacità di comunicazione, con esperienza che presenta alla leadership esecutiva e al pubblico di livello del Consiglio. - Forte mentalità commerciale, finanziaria e analitica, bilanciando l'esperienza degli ospiti, fattibilità operativa, linee temporali e investimenti. - Esperienza di collaborazione con designer, architetti, agenzie creative e team operativi per offrire ambienti e esperienze immersive, fisiche. - Proficienza con Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) e strumenti di presentazione per sviluppare concetti convincenti e comunicazioni esecutive focalizzate sulla consegna di esperienze fisiche. - Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio. - Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale fino al 30%. I tuoi essenziali - Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

descriptionByLocale.de: Dein Zweck Der Senior Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery ist dafür verantwortlich, die nächste Generation von Gästeerlebnissen in der neuen Klasse von MSC Cruises zum Leben zu erwecken. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktinnovationsteam verwandelt diese Rolle genehmigte Konzepte in vollständig realisierte Onboard-Erlebnisse und stellt sicher, dass sie operativ ausführbar, kommerziell erfolgreich und auf die Marke MSC Cruises ausgerichtet sind. Als Leiter der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von End-to-End-Gästereisen, Servicekonzepten und Onboard-Erlebnissen stellt der Senior Director sicher, dass jede Erfahrung vom Schiffsdesign und der Betriebsplanung bis hin zur Auslieferung der Besatzung und der Aktivierung der Gäste startbereit ist. Die Rolle spielt auch eine wichtige Rolle bei der Definition, wie neue Erfahrungen den Gästen präsentiert werden, und arbeitet mit internen Teams zusammen, um überzeugende Storytelling-, Positionierungs- und Go-to-Market-Strategien zu gestalten, die das Engagement der Gäste und die kommerzielle Wirkung maximieren. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner der Geschäftsleitung präsentiert der Senior Director regelmäßig Fortschritt, Empfehlungen und Lieferstrategien für die geschäftsführenden Stakeholder, einschließlich des CEO und des Chairman, um die Abstimmung von der Konzeptgenehmigung bis zum erfolgreichen Start sicherzustellen. Ihre Wirkung Erfahrung Entwicklung & Lieferung - Führen Sie die End-to-End-Entwicklung und Bereitstellung neuer Gästeerlebnisse, vom genehmigten Konzept bis zum Schiffsstart. - Übersetzen Sie genehmigte Konzepte in Gästereisen, Servicemodelle, Betriebsanforderungen und Startpläne. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass jede Erfahrung der ursprünglichen Vision treu bleibt und gleichzeitig operativ machbar, kommerziell erfolgreich und auf die Markenstandards von MSC Cruises ausgerichtet ist. Guest Experience Exzellenz - Champion gastzentrierte Erlebnisse, die Gastfreundschaft, Storytelling, Service Excellence und kommerzielle Leistung kombinieren. - Entwerfen Sie unvergessliche End-to-End-Gästereisen, die emotionales Engagement schaffen und die Gästezufriedenheit verbessern. - Wenden Sie branchenübliche Best Practices und kontinuierliche Innovationen an, um die Erfahrung an Bord in der gesamten Flotte zu verbessern. Funktionale Führung - Führen Sie die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, Architekten, Designern und externen Partnern, um erfolgreich neue Gästeerlebnisse zu liefern. - Gewährleistung der Abstimmung zwischen Schiffsentwurf, Baumeilensteinen, Einsatzbereitschaft und Startaktivitäten. - Verwalten Sie Erwartungen, Prioritäten, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Entscheidungsfindung während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus. Projekt- und Liefermanagement - Überwachen Sie Projektpläne, Budgets, Zeitpläne, Meilensteine, Risiken und Ergebnisse in mehreren Initiativen. - Unterstützen Sie den SVP mit Budgetaufsicht, Executive Reporting, strategischen Empfehlungen und Delivery Governance. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass Projekte ordnungsgemäß geplant, mit Ressourcen ausgestattet und pünktlich, in ihrem Umfang und in Übereinstimmung mit den Geschäftszielen geliefert werden. Exekutivkommunikation - Bereiten und liefern Sie wirkungsvolle Präsentationen und Projektaktualisierungen für Führungskräfte, einschließlich CEO und Chairman. - Lieferfortschritte, wichtige Entscheidungen, Risiken, Kompromisse und Empfehlungen klar kommunizieren. - Unterstützen Sie die Entscheidungsfindung von Führungskräften mit datengesteuerten Erkenntnissen, operativen Überlegungen und Perspektiven für das Gasterlebnis. Teamleitung - Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team von Gasterlebnis-Profis. - Aufbau von Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Guest Journey Design, Hospitality Delivery, Stakeholder Management, Projektdurchführung und operative Integration. - Fördern Sie eine kollaborative, rechenschaftspflichtige, innovative und gastfreundliche Kultur und entwickeln Sie zukünftige Führungstalente. Performance & Continuous Improvement - Definieren, überwachen und melden Sie KPIs in Bezug auf Startbereitschaft, Gästezufriedenheit, operative Annahme, Erfahrungsqualität und kommerzielle Leistung. - Führen Sie Bewertungen nach dem Start, erfassen Sie die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse und implementieren Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen, um die Bereitstellung zukünftiger Erfahrungen zu stärken. - Förderung einer Kultur der Exzellenz, Innovation und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung bei allen Aktivitäten zur Entwicklung von Gästeerlebnissen. Deine Reise bisher - Bachelor-Abschluss erforderlich; MBA oder andere fortgeschrittene Grad bevorzugt. - 12+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Bereitstellung physischer Gästeerlebnisse im Weltraum in Gastgewerbe, Kreuzfahrtschiffen, Resorts, Themenunterhaltung oder ähnlichen serviceorientierten Umgebungen, mit einem klaren Fokus auf Onboard- oder On-Site-Erlebnissen anstelle digitaler Produkte. - Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz der führenden großen, gastorientierten physischen Erfahrungsprojekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung in komplexen Betriebsumgebungen wie Schiffen, Hotels oder Resorts. - Starkes Verständnis des physischen Gasterlebnisdesigns, des Gastgewerbes, der Servicequalität und der persönlichen Entwicklung der Customer Journey in gebauten Umgebungen. - Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, strategische Konzepte in operativ ausführbare, greifbare Erfahrungen zu übersetzen und Pläne in physischen Räumen zu starten. - Erfahrene Führungskraft mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, leistungsstarke, funktionsübergreifende Teams aufzubauen, zu entwickeln und zu inspirieren. - Ausgezeichnetes Stakeholder-Management, Einflussnahme und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit Erfahrung in der Führungskräfte- und Vorstandsebene. - Starke kommerzielle, finanzielle und analytische Denkweise, ausgewogenes Gästeerlebnis, operative Machbarkeit, Zeitpläne und Investitionen. - Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Designern, Architekten, Kreativagenturen und operativen Teams, um immersive, physische Umgebungen und Erlebnisse zu liefern. - Kenntnisse mit Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) und Präsentationstools zur Entwicklung überzeugender Konzepte und Kommunikation für Führungskräfte, die sich auf die Bereitstellung physischer Erlebnisse konzentrieren. - Fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil. - Bereitschaft, international bis zu 30% zu reisen. Ihre Essentials - Unser Engagement Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die verschiedene Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben sie sich noch heute, um teil eines globalen teams zu sein, das grenzen überschreitet und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery est chargé d'animer la prochaine génération d'expériences d'invités à travers la nouvelle classe de navires de MSC Cruises. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe d'innovation produit, ce rôle transforme les concepts approuvés en expériences embarquées pleinement réalisées, en s'assurant qu'ils sont opérationnelment exécutables, commercialement réussis et alignés avec la marque MSC Cruises. Dirigant l'élaboration et la prestation de voyages de bout en bout, de concepts de service et d'expériences à bord, le directeur s'assure que chaque expérience est prête à être lancée de la conception et de la planification opérationnelle du navire à la livraison de l'équipage et à l'activation des invités. Le rôle joue également un rôle clé dans la définition de la façon dont de nouvelles expériences sont présentées aux invités, en s'associant avec des équipes internes pour façonner des stratégies convaincantes de narration, de positionnement et de mise en marché qui maximisent l'engagement des clients et leur impact commercial. En tant que partenaire de confiance de la haute direction, le directeur principal présente régulièrement les progrès, les recommandations et les stratégies d'exécution aux intervenants exécutifs, y compris le PDG et le président, en assurant l'harmonisation entre l'approbation du concept et le lancement réussi. Votre impact Développement et prestation de l'expérience - Diriger le développement de bout en bout et la livraison de nouvelles expériences d'invités, du concept approuvé au lancement de navires. - Traduire les concepts approuvés en voyages invités, modèles de service, exigences opérationnelles et plans de lancement. - Assurez-vous que chaque expérience demeure fidèle à la vision initiale tout en étant opérationnellement réalisable, commercialement réussie et alignée sur les normes de marque de MSC Cruises. Excellence de l'expérience des invités - Expériences centrées sur les invités, qui combinent l'hospitalité, la narration, l'excellence du service et la performance commerciale. - Concevoir des voyages de bout en bout mémorables qui créent un engagement émotionnel et améliorent la satisfaction des clients. - Appliquer les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie et l'innovation continue pour accroître les expériences à bord de la flotte. Leadership interfonctionnel - Diriger la collaboration entre Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architectes, concepteurs et partenaires externes pour offrir avec succès de nouvelles expériences aux clients. - Assurer l'alignement entre la conception des navires, les étapes de construction, la préparation opérationnelle et les activités de lancement. - Gérer les attentes, les priorités, les risques, les dépendances et la prise de décisions des intervenants tout au long du cycle de vie du projet. Communication exécutive - Préparer et présenter des présentations à impact élevé et des mises à jour de projets à l'intention des cadres supérieurs, y compris le PDG et le président. - Communiquer clairement les progrès de la prestation, les décisions clés, les risques, les compromis et les recommandations. - Appuyer la prise de décisions par les cadres avec des idées fondées sur les données, des considérations opérationnelles et des perspectives d'expérience des invités. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented copywriter to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys for a temporary contract of 6 months, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

We are seeking a highly skilled and Gen-AI savvy copywriter to shape how our brand is experienced through language. This role is central to delivering a refined, consistent, and emotionally resonant brand voice across all guest touchpoints—from digital platforms to in-suite experiences and global campaigns.

Your Impact

- Creative copywriting and storytelling: Craft compelling, elegant, and brand-aligned copy across all channels. Write high-quality editorial content such as brand stories, destination narratives, and hospitality experiences.

- Precise editing: Translate complex hospitality offerings into clear, emotionally engaging messaging that elevates perceived value. A talent to make the long or unclear: short, simple and impactful, ensuring every word reflects the sophistication, warmth, and exclusivity expected in a luxury hospitality environment. Ability to edit across differentiated channels and large volumes of copy.

- Proofreading: proofread and refine all copy to ensure grammatical accuracy, luxury vocabulary and articulation and stylistic consistency.

- Tone of Voice: maintain a consistent luxury brand tone of voice across multiple assets. Continuously evolve copy frameworks, messaging guidelines, and tone-of-voice documentation

- AI amplification to deliver scale and speed: use AI tools (e.g. generative writing assistants) to enhance brainstorming, editing, efficiency, and scale while maintaining impeccable human taste and judgment to ensure all copy meets brand editorial standards.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

- 5+ years of professional copywriting experience within luxury or luxury travel/hospitality

- Excellent storytelling skills, with a refined aesthetic sensibility and understanding of luxury brand positioning. A strong portfolio demonstrating sophisticated, persuasive, and brand-sensitive copy

- Demonstrated flexibility to adapt tone for different audiences (e.g. B2B vs B2C) and different channels (e.g. Press releases vs. Customer Service FAQs vs In-suite letters, with proven experience writing for digital platforms) while maintaining brand integrity

- Proven experience prompting AI tools across ideation, content creation, and editing to augment capacity and increase output, while keeping strong editorial judgment over final copy

- Familiarity with GEO & SEO copywriting principles

- Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence

Your Essentials

- Native English speaker a non-negotiable must, native British English speaker preferred

- Exceptional command of English writing, editing, and proofreading

- Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment

- Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation

- Deep appreciation for luxury hospitality, travel experiences, and high-end service culture. Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever evolving and luxury travel industry

- Self-learner, continuously testing and learning with creative technologies and AI-assisted workflows

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Il tuo scopo Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso. Esiste un'opportunità emozionante per un copywriter di talento per unire il nostro nuovo marchio di viaggio di lusso Explora Viaggi per un contratto temporaneo di 6 mesi, basato nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, in Svizzera. Siamo alla ricerca di un copywriter esperto e Gen-AI per modellare come il nostro marchio è vissuto attraverso la lingua. Questo ruolo è fondamentale per fornire una voce di marca raffinata, coerente ed emotivamente risonante in tutti i punti di contatto degli ospiti - dalle piattaforme digitali alle esperienze in-suite e campagne globali. Il tuo impatto - Creative copywriting e storytelling: Artigianato copia avvincente, elegante e allineata al marchio su tutti i canali. Scrivere contenuti editoriali di alta qualità come storie di marca, narrazioni di destinazione e esperienze di ospitalità. - editing preciso: Tradurre offerte di ospitalità complesse in messaggistica chiara, emotivamente coinvolgente che eleva valore percepito. Un talento per rendere il lungo o poco chiaro: breve, semplice e impattante, assicurando che ogni parola rifletta la raffinatezza, il calore e l'esclusività prevista in un ambiente di ospitalità di lusso. Capacità di modificare attraverso canali differenziati e grandi volumi di copia. - Proofreading: proofread e raffinate tutte le copie per garantire accuratezza grammaticale, vocabolario di lusso e articolazione e coerenza stilistica. - Tono di Voce: mantenere un tono di marca di lusso coerente di voce in più beni. Evoluzione continua dei quadri di copia, delle linee guida di messaggistica e della documentazione di tono di voce - Amplificazione AI per fornire scala e velocità: utilizzare strumenti AI (ad esempio assistenti di scrittura generativa) per migliorare brainstorming, editing, efficienza e scala mantenendo il gusto e il giudizio umano impeccabile per garantire che tutte le copie soddisfino gli standard editoriali del marchio. Il tuo viaggio finora - Corso di laurea o master - 5+ anni di esperienza di copywriting professionale all'interno di viaggi di lusso o di lusso/ospitalità - Eccellente capacità di narrazione, con una raffinata sensibilità estetica e comprensione del posizionamento del marchio di lusso. Un portafoglio forte che dimostra una copia sofisticata, persuasa e sensibile al marchio - Dimostrata flessibilità per adattarsi al tono per il pubblico diverso (ad esempio B2B vs B2C) e a diversi canali (ad esempio comunicati stampa vs. Customer Service FAQs vs In-suite letter, con comprovata esperienza di scrittura per piattaforme digitali) mantenendo l'integrità del marchio - Provata esperienza che spinge gli strumenti AI attraverso l'ideazione, la creazione di contenuti, e la modifica alla capacità di aumento e aumentare la produzione, mantenendo forte giudizio editoriale su copia finale - Familiarità con i principi di copywriting GEO & SEO - Prove capacità di roll-up le maniche ed eseguire con eccellenza I tuoi essenziali - madrelingua inglese un must non negoziabile, madrelingua inglese preferito - Comando eccezionale di scrittura, editing e correzione inglese - Strutturato, ben organizzato, orientato ai dettagli e in grado di gestire più progetti, prosperando in un ambiente di avvio veloce - Collaborazione eccezionale e capacità di influenzare, con comprovata capacità di navigare in un'organizzazione di matrice - Profondo apprezzamento per l'ospitalità di lusso, le esperienze di viaggio e la cultura di servizio di fascia alta. Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente il settore dei viaggi in continua evoluzione e lusso - Autoapprendimento, test e apprendimento continuo con tecnologie creative e flussi di lavoro assistiti da AI A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia. 
• Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare. Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a commercially driven and digitally fluent Marketing & Media Senior Manager to lead digital & paid media delivery across multiple markets out of our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.
The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, has strong all round marketing knowledge (marketing, trade marketing, PR) with deep expertise in paid media and digital performance marketing, and understands the nuances of luxury consumer behaviour across diverse global audiences.

Your Impact

1.    Local Media / Marketing Leadership
•    Depending on the size and staffing of the markets in your scope, act as either the local digital media lead, local media lead or local marketing lead.
•    Ensure media campaigns drive brand strategy and align with global standards, while  reflecting local audience behaviour, seasonal demand patterns, language requirements, and cultural nuances.
•    Partner with local sales and marketing teams to support market-specific business and commercial objectives, and with global marketing and media teams to ensure strategic and executional brand consistency.

2.    Digital Campaign Delivery
•    Lead the end-to-end delivery of digital marketing campaigns across multiple markets, ensuring timely execution, consistency, with all placements and asset adaptations meeting luxury brand standards
•    Coordinate with creative, content, CRM, ecommerce, and digital teams to ensure seamless campaign integration and customer journey alignment.

3.    Paid Media Strategy & Performance
•    Develop & execute local paid media strategies across multiple markets.
•    Manage local agency, platforms and media partner relationships.

4.    Measurement & performance analysis

Own the integrated measurement of media across the marketing funnel. Monitor and analyse performance and optimize investments to drive brand awareness, revenue growth, customer acquisition, and direct bookings, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement, including reports and presentations for senior leadership.

5.    Media thought leadership & innovation

Own the innovation plan across channels. Identify the latest media industry developments, recommending test & learn plans to integrate the relevant areas to Explora journey’s media strategy.

6.    Build media literacy

Step-change media knowledge in markets across departments to enhance media planning capabilities and excellence in delivery.

7.    Budget management

Own the global media budget planning, spending and stewardship, including agency/vendor management

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

- 15+ years of client side roles in global and local media including planning, ATL/BTL and directly running digital media

- Strong marketing knowledge (marketing, trade marketing, PR)

- Outstanding luxury media understanding: in-depth knowledge of offline and digital media, the interdependencies between paid, owned and earned media, as well as luxury media specifics

- Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence

- Track record of managing agencies, platforms and media partners and building effective partnerships

Your Essentials

- Strategic and innovative critical thinker.

- Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment.

- Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation. Effectively organize teams to deliver business outcomes.

- Proven analytical skills with proficiency in media tools and platforms

- Strong preference for prior experience in the luxury or luxury hospitality/travel industry. A personal passion for luxury travel and global mindset.

- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving media industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un Marketing & Media Senior Manager commercialmente guidato e digitalmente fluente per condurre la distribuzione digitale e dei media pagati su più mercati fuori dai nostri uffici a Ginevra, Svizzera. Il candidato ideale combina il pensiero strategico con l'eccellenza operativa, ha forti conoscenze di marketing a tutto tondo (marketing, marketing commerciale, PR) con una profonda esperienza nei media retribuiti e nel marketing digitale delle prestazioni, e comprende le sfumature del comportamento dei consumatori di lusso attraverso diversi pubblici globali. Il tuo impatto 1. Leadership dei media locali / Marketing
• A seconda delle dimensioni e del personale dei mercati nel vostro campo di applicazione, agire come sia il piombo digitale locale media, piombo media locale o piombo di marketing locale.
• Assicurarsi che le campagne multimediali guidino la strategia del marchio e si allineino agli standard globali, riflettendo il comportamento del pubblico locale, i modelli di domanda stagionale, i requisiti linguistici e le sfumature culturali.
• Collabora con i team di vendita e marketing locali per supportare obiettivi commerciali e commerciali specifici sul mercato, e con i team di marketing e media globali per garantire la coerenza strategica ed esecutiva del marchio. 2. Consegna della campagna digitale
• Condurre la consegna end-to-end di campagne di marketing digitale su più mercati, assicurando l'esecuzione tempestiva, la coerenza, con tutti i posizionamenti e gli adattamenti patrimoniali che soddisfano gli standard del marchio di lusso
• Coordinate con team creativi, contenuti, CRM, ecommerce e digitali per garantire l'integrazione della campagna senza soluzione di continuità e l'allineamento del percorso del cliente. 3. Strategia e performance dei media
• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie multimediali a pagamento locali su più mercati.
• Gestisci le relazioni di agenzia locale, piattaforme e partner media. 4. Analisi delle misurazioni e delle prestazioni Possedere la misura integrata dei media attraverso l'imbuto di marketing. Monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni e ottimizzare gli investimenti per guidare la consapevolezza del marchio, la crescita dei ricavi, l'acquisizione dei clienti e le prenotazioni dirette, fornendo approfondimenti e raccomandazioni per il miglioramento continuo, inclusi report e presentazioni per la leadership senior. 5. Leader & innovazione dei media Proprio il piano di innovazione attraverso i canali. Identificare gli ultimi sviluppi del settore dei media, raccomandando test e imparare i piani per integrare le aree rilevanti per la strategia dei media di Explora. 6. Costruisci l'alfabetizzazione dei media Scambio della conoscenza dei media nei mercati di tutti i dipartimenti per migliorare le capacità di pianificazione dei media e l'eccellenza nella consegna. 7. Gestione del bilancio Possedere alla pianificazione, alla spesa e alla gestione del budget dei media globali, compresa la gestione dell'agenzia/vendor Il tuo viaggio finora - Corso di laurea o master - 15+ anni di ruoli lato client nei media globali e locali, tra cui pianificazione, ATL/BTL e gestione diretta dei media digitali - Forte conoscenza di marketing (marketing, marketing commerciale, PR) - Comprensione dei media di lusso: conoscenza approfondita dei media offline e digitali, interdipendenze tra i media pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati, così come specifiche dei media di lusso - Prove capacità di roll-up le maniche ed eseguire con eccellenza - Tracciare il record di agenzie di gestione, piattaforme e partner multimediali e costruire partnership efficaci I tuoi essenziali - Pensatore critico strategico e innovativo. - Strutturato, ben organizzato, orientato al dettaglio, e in grado di gestire più progetti, prosperando in un ambiente di avvio veloce e veloce. - Collaborazione eccezionale e capacità di influenzare, con comprovata capacità di navigare in un'organizzazione di matrice. Efficacemente organizzare i team per fornire risultati aziendali. - Prove competenze analitiche con competenza in strumenti e piattaforme multimediali - Forte preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore lusso o lusso ospitalità / viaggio. Una passione personale per i viaggi di lusso e la mentalità globale. - Ottima capacità di comunicazione, sia scritta che verbale. Fluente in inglese. - Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria dei media in continua evoluzione. A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo i viaggi oceanici di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia. Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare. Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

jobs.title: Marketing Full Funnel Analyst
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

- The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.
Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Develop attribution models (e.g.  media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency.

- Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of marketing measurement methodologies including attribution modelling, media mix modelling, customer segmentation, and ROI analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Shore Excursions Fleet Supervisor oversees all aspects of Shore Excursions on board MSC Fleet and Is responsible and accountable for driving sales through the effective coaching of the Shore Excursions teams in areas such as profit growth, expense control, product training, staff development and customer service. The goal is to ensure compliance with corporate standards, enhance operational excellence, maximize revenue performance, and improve customer satisfaction scores.

Your Impact

- Monitor and supervise the performance of the assigned ships to achieve Company's assigned targets.

- Support the onboard team to achieve maximum revenue and Guests' Satisfaction

- Ensure application/implementation of company standard and procedures

- Coach and train onboard teams ensuring active team participation

- Audit safety procedures in place with our Tour Operators

Your Journey so far

- At least 4 years of experience in the role of onboard Shorex Manager

- Fluent in English (minimum B2) and any additional language is a plus

- Computer proficiency with the MS Office Package

- Knowledge of onboard booking systems is an advantage

- Analytical skills

- Experience in training and people development

- Strong Interpersonal and Communication skills

- This is a crew contract involving a long period of travel on board our ships and our offices

The Fleet Supervisor’s activities are supervised and coordinated by the Corporate Team, to whom they report all actions, ideas, and implementations, while also providing relevant analyses to monitor and enhance the results required by the Company.

Your Essentials

Hold a valid passport

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Your Impact

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees.

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- leadership pipeline development

- career development frameworks

- Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore.

- Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks.

Leadership Development

- Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations.

- Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture.

- Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as:

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

Your Journey so far

Education

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development.

- Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces.

- Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations.

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

Key Competences

- Strategic Learning & Capability Development

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture

- Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organizational Development

- Learning Technology & Digital Learning

Your Essentials

- Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The New Builds Business Analyst plays a key role in ensuring the financial, commercial, and operational success of MSC Cruises' new ship development projects. Acting as the financial and analytical partner to the New Builds department, this role is responsible for defining, monitoring, and optimizing departmental budgets, overseeing owner-supplied materials (OS&E and FF&E where applicable), and ensuring sound financial governance throughout the project lifecycle.

Beyond budget management, the Business Analyst delivers data-driven analyses and recommendations to support decision-making across front-of-house and back-of-house initiatives. By evaluating investments, costs, operational models, and project performance, the role helps ensure that innovation, guest experience, and operational efficiency are achieved within financial objectives.

Working closely with Finance, Procurement, Technical, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, Guest Experience, Design, and external partners, the Business Analyst provides insights that support specification decisions, supplier strategies, budget optimization, and overall project profitability. The role also develops reporting, dashboards, and KPIs to monitor performance, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure alignment between financial objectives and the strategic goals of the New Builds department.

Your Impact

- Oversee the definition, tracking, and monitoring of the New Builds hotel and guest operations budget, ensuring alignment with financial goals and preventing cost overruns. Provide regular updates on budget performance to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

- Conduct financial forecasting for New Builds projects, ensuring expenditures are kept in line with approved budgets. Analyse financial data and provide insights to improve profitability, cost control, and resource allocation.

- Manage the budget and coordination of owner-supplied materials, ensuring timely delivery, cost efficiency, and alignment with project specifications. Track and report related costs to enhance budget forecasting accuracy.

- Collaborate with finance, procurement, F&B, technical/operational departments, and guest experience teams to ensure financial and strategic alignment across all New Builds projects.

- Lead and execute ad-hoc business analyses to evaluate the financial impact of decisions related to New Builds projects, with a focus on increasing profitability, reducing costs, and improving operational efficiency.

- Identify potential financial risks, including budget overruns, supply chain disruptions, or delays in owner-supplied materials. Coordinate with all departments involved to address these risks and prevent project timeline disruptions.

- Track and report on key financial and operational performance indicators (KPIs) for New Builds projects. Ensure data-driven insights are used to optimize project outcomes and support decision-making.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

- Maximum 3 or 4 years of relevant experience in budget management, financial analysis, procurement, or contract management, preferably within the cruise, hospitality, or construction industry.

- Strong financial acumen with experience in managing budgets, financial forecasting, and reporting. Working towards aligning financial and strategic goals.

- Proven ability to manage contracts, oversee vendor relationships, and coordinate third-party suppliers.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with finance, procurement, operational, and technical teams.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to provide data-driven insights and recommendations.

- Proficient in financial software, budgeting tools, and key computer applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

- Ability to ensure leadership is informed of updates, project status, and deadlines through clear communication and regular status reports.

- Proactive and collaborative attitude, with strong interpersonal skills.

- Willingness to perform additional duties as assigned by management to support the overall success of the New Builds department.

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

- Strong Excel and Power BI skills

- Strong analytics skills

- Great command of English is required

- Right to work in Switzerland

Essendo il partner finanziario e analitico del dipartimento New Builds, questo ruolo è responsabile della definizione, del monitoraggio e dell'ottimizzazione dei bilanci dipartimentali, della supervisione dei materiali forniti dal proprietario (OS&E e FF&E, ove applicabile), e della corretta governance finanziaria durante il ciclo di vita del progetto. Oltre alla gestione del bilancio, il Business Analyst fornisce analisi e raccomandazioni basate sui dati per supportare il processo decisionale attraverso iniziative di fronte-di-house e back-of-house. Lavorando a stretto contatto con Finance, Procurement, Technical, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, Guest Experience, Design e partner esterni, il Business Analyst fornisce informazioni che supportano le decisioni specifiche, le strategie dei fornitori, l'ottimizzazione del budget e la redditività complessiva del progetto. Il ruolo sviluppa anche reportage, dashboard e KPI per monitorare le prestazioni, identificare i rischi e le opportunità, e garantire l'allineamento tra gli obiettivi finanziari e gli obiettivi strategici del dipartimento New Builds. Coordinare con tutti i dipartimenti coinvolti per affrontare questi rischi e prevenire interruzioni della timeline del progetto. - Traccia e segnala gli indicatori chiave di performance finanziarie e operative (KPI) per i progetti New Builds. Assicurarsi che le informazioni basate sui dati vengano utilizzate per ottimizzare i risultati del progetto e supportare il processo decisionale. Il tuo viaggio finora - Laurea in Business Administration, finanza, contabilità, o un campo relativo. - Massimo 3 o 4 anni di esperienza rilevante nella gestione del bilancio, nell'analisi finanziaria, nell'approvvigionamento o nella gestione dei contratti, preferibilmente all'interno dell'industria della crociera, dell'ospitalità o dell'edilizia. - Forte acume finanziario con esperienza nella gestione dei bilanci, previsioni finanziarie e reporting. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but L'analyste d'affaires New Builds joue un rôle clé dans la réussite financière, commerciale et opérationnelle des nouveaux projets de développement de navires de MSC Cruises. En tant que partenaire financier et analytique du ministère des Nouvelles constructions, ce rôle est chargé de définir, de surveiller et d'optimiser les budgets ministériels, de superviser les matériaux fournis par les propriétaires (OS&E et FF&E, le cas échéant) et d'assurer une saine gouvernance financière tout au long du cycle de vie du projet. Au-delà de la gestion budgétaire, l'analyste des affaires effectue des analyses et des recommandations axées sur les données afin d'appuyer la prise de décisions dans toutes les initiatives internes et internes. En évaluant les investissements, les coûts, les modèles opérationnels et le rendement des projets, le rôle contribue à garantir que l'innovation, l'expérience des invités et l'efficacité opérationnelle sont réalisées dans le respect des objectifs financiers. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires financiers, d'approvisionnement, techniques, d'exploitation hôtelière, d'alimentation et de boissons, d'expérience client, de conception et d'extérieur, l'analyste d'affaires fournit des renseignements qui appuient les décisions de spécification, les stratégies des fournisseurs, l'optimisation budgétaire et la rentabilité globale du projet. Le rôle consiste également à élaborer des rapports, des tableaux de bord et des ICR pour surveiller le rendement, cerner les risques et les possibilités et assurer l'harmonisation entre les objectifs financiers et les objectifs stratégiques du ministère des Nouvelles constructions.
